description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class named UniqueRouteKeyTest that verifies the uniqueness of route keys across multiple plugin configurations in the OrangeHRM project. It loads route definitions from YAML files for each plugin and checks for duplicate route keys, asserting success if none are found or throwing an exception if duplicates exist.

classes.name: UniqueRouteKeyTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class to ensure uniqueness of route keys within plugin route configuration files.

methods.name: testUniqueRouteKey
methods.description: Test method that loads plugin route YAML files, checks for duplicate route keys, and throws an exception if duplicates are found.
